title: Steelpecker
subtitle: Creature
description: Though mainly found on Jakku, the steelpecker could also be found in other parts of the galaxy like Ferrix. With razor-sharp talons and beaks, these ornery bird-like creatures devour vanadium, osmiridium, and corundum in their gizzards, which helped break down their metallic meals. Folks were wise to avoid these vicious creatures in their colonies because they would go on the attack.
